name: com.tencent.timpush.xiaomi.XiaomiMsgReceiver
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Xiaomi adapter receives Xiaomi message and registration broadcasts. It returns registration results to Tencent Cloud IM and records notification-arrival, notification-click, and pass-through callbacks.
disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM stops receiving Xiaomi registration results through this receiver, so Xiaomi offline-push registration stops refreshing.
